_about: Dimethyl ether (1) + methanol (2): isothermal total pressures at 323.15 K from Park, Han, Gmehling (2007). Rows: temperature in K (the set's constraint), liquid mole fraction of dimethyl ether, pressure in kPa as in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured in the same apparatus.

source.citation: S.-J. Park, K.-J. Han, J. Gmehling, Vapor-Liquid Equilibria and HE for Binary Systems of Dimethyl Ether (DME) with C1-C4 Alkan-1-ols at 323.15 K and Liquid-Liquid Equilibria for Ternary System of DME + Methanol + Water at 313.15 K, J. Chem. Eng. Data 52 (2007) 230-234
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7: methanol + dimethyl ether, vapour pressure, variable mole fraction of dimethyl ether (liquid), constraint T = 323.15 K. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties in the record: 0.25 to 5.1 kPa. Values as stored in the ThermoML record (XML file), extracted with validation/python/thermoml_read.py; nothing converted or rounded. To be checked by a person against the record before use (AGENTS.md rule 4).
